title: W7 E -- Ruler and continuous-view top gap
description: Read AGENTS.md, team/PROTOCOL.md, docs/design-system.md, docs/agent-work/2026-11-04-ui-wave-7/REQUEST.md (decisions included), docs/agent-work/2026-11-04-ui-wave-7/RESEARCH.md and shots/. Brief: node_modules/.cache/personal-word-beta/ui6-brief.md (board steps, pinned Node, private Playwright config, SERIAL LOCK, Never list). Shared files src/styles.css, src/App.tsx stay on no task: edit your regions only, Edit tool, re-read first. Do not touch README.md, ROADMAP.md, docs/case-study.md (uncommitted owner review). Never commit. Doc notes go to docs/agent-work/2026-11-04-ui-wave-7/notes/<task>.md, not docs/*.md. Fail-first evidence in the done note. Port 1936, scratch ui7-e. Use an Opus-class worker: touches document settings and exports. Build RESEARCH section 1 with owner decisions: a toggleable horizontal ruler (toggle on the toolbar, shot 5 is the reference), linked sides: dragging either marker moves both and changes the real document margin exports use, the same setting as today's margin dropdown. A handle shown only while the ruler is on adjusts the continuous-view top gap: top of the document only, scrolls away, screen-only, never reaches exports, default 32 px (editor.css:415). Must survive native serialization, saves, snapshots, imports and exports per AGENTS.md Preserve writing (cargo test if Rust is affected; never rename folio.* keys). Works at zoom, in split view, page and continuous view; tick marks as real elements; keyboard access for every drag. Margin cap: screen allows 1.5 in, export 2 in (formatting.ts:126): decide with evidence and record it, do not silently change export output for existing documents. Say whether Cmd-Z undoes a drag. PDF/Word page parity is not promised. Native WebKit is checked by W7 V; list what it must check. Acceptance: tsc, npm test, tests/ruler.spec.ts plus specs covering page view, margins and exports, an exported DOCX/PDF showing the changed margin.

handoff.text: Keep the app code, including the padding CSS and the scrollMargin effect; both measured right. Fix tests only. (1 firm) Full suite: tests/markdown-roundtrip.spec.ts:190 and :379 fail 5 of 5 alone and pass 3 of 3 on the same bundle with only the .is-continuous padding rule removed. buildRichProject clicks the centre of the 'Closing paragraph' box; the wider column puts that centre (x 855) on the footnote marker (851 to 859.7), giving a node selection that End does not move, and [^2] is lost from the export. Change the click so it cannot land on the marker (near the line start), register the unowned spec, run the WHOLE suite. The done note's 'no other spec depended on the old width' is wrong. (2 same pass) tests/ruler.spec.ts caretTop reads getClientRects()[0], which at a soft wrap is the previous line's end: 26 of 110 false hidden at 150% page view, 0 of 110 by view.coordsAtPos(head, 1); use coordsAtPos, since CI has no Futura. The ruler-off test never asserts the margin: turn ruler on then off, assert scrollMargin 5 and scrollThreshold 0, remove console.log SCROLLTRACE. (N2 same pass) first glyph sits 8 px inside the left marker in continuous view (6, 8, 10, 12 at 75, 100, 125, 150), 0 in page view; the owner would see it. Add to src/editor/editor.css: .is-continuous .editor-paper .writing-surface { padding-left: 0; padding-right: 0 }; do not touch styles.css. Tried by injected style: offset 0, lists and blockquotes fine. Column goes 608 to 624 px, matching page view and exports, so some lines rewrap: say so in the notes. Make the alignment test measure the glyph, not the .ProseMirror box. Owner's call, not a defect: toggle in Page setup (keyboard reachable, four Tabs) versus on the toolbar.
